research.title: About the Research
research.description: CocoCast AI is developed as a research-based smart agriculture dashboard for coconut yield prediction. The system focuses on combining IoT micro-climatic data with historical records.
research.footer_quote: Empowering Sri Lankan agriculture through artificial intelligence and IoT technology.

overview.title: How CocoCast AI works
overview.subtitle: A grounded pipeline from the field node to the cloud dashboard, designed for live monitoring and research reporting.
overview.esp32_desc: Samples DHT22, soil moisture AO, and BH1750 light data on a configurable schedule.
overview.db_desc: Stores latest status, sync metadata, and the nested reading history tree in Firebase.
overview.intel_desc: Converts live telemetry into trend charts, field health scores, and action alerts.
overview.dash_desc: Presents a modern control room view with live cards, charts, and history at a glance.
overview.live_sensing_desc: Sensors push readings every configured interval.
overview.cloud_sync_desc: Firebase keeps latest and historical data accessible.
overview.op_health_desc: Connectivity, interval, and device state are visible.
overview.low_power_desc: Deep sleep keeps the node efficient between samples.
